description: Defines the interface for the DisplayVk class, which implements Vulkan display functionalities in ANGLE's renderer. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and virtual functions related to Vulkan display management.

classes.name: DisplayVk
classes.description: Class implementing Vulkan display functionalities, inheriting from DisplayImpl and vk::Context, providing methods for display initialization, surface creation, error handling, and feature management.
